name: Taj River View Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: On the Barot–Kothi Kohar–Bada Gran road on the bank of the Uhl river, owner Ajay Thakur runs the most-reviewed restaurant in the Barot pocket (4.1/5 on TripAdvisor). The trout is the order — sourced from the local hatchery downstream and grilled or fried to request.
insider_tip: Day-trippers can drop in for lunch — call ahead so the kitchen pulls fresh trout from the hatchery rather than serving frozen stock. Crockery and presentation are rough; the food is the point.
signature_address: Barot–Kothi Kohar–Bada Gran Rd, Multhan, Mandi 175013

name: The Heimat Resort
why_it_matters: River-view tented camp on the Uhl, the most-reviewed property in Barot itself (4.3/5 on JustDial across 395 reviews). Resident kitchen runs a small daily menu; the standout is grilled trout served beside the evening bonfire — a fixed pattern in guest reviews.
insider_tip: Menu is short and the kitchen runs slow at peak — order trout when you check in so it's grilled by sunset, not waiting on a 7pm rush. Non-residents can request lunch by phone if capacity allows.

name: Hotel Barot Valley
why_it_matters: Rooftop restaurant inside a basic hotel at Lakkar Bazaar near the Shanan Hydel Project bridge — Barot's de facto budget dining room. Dinner trout here is cheaper than Heimat or Taj River View, and breakfast paratha (cooked by long-time staffer Jaggu) is the recurring praise point in guest reviews.
insider_tip: It's a hotel rooftop, not a destination kitchen — eat for the price-to-river-view ratio, not the technique. Avoid the Chinese menu; stick to trout, dal, paratha.
signature_address: Lakkar Bazaar, near Shanan Hydel Project Bridge, Barot, Mandi 175013

name: Hotel Roshan
why_it_matters: Small family-run hotel near Durga Mata Temple Road — the kitchen is in-house and serves what the family is eating that day rather than a printed menu. 4.4/5 on JustDial across 233 reviews; Mr. Balbir is the named host who handles meal requests for non-residents.
insider_tip: Walk-ins for meals only with a phone call ahead — the kitchen cooks on order, not from a buffet. If you want trout, source from the hatchery downstream and ask Balbir if they'll cook it for you.
signature_address: Near Durga Mata Temple Road, Barot 175013
